Definition: from G4314 and G3784; to be indebted additionally:--over besides.
BiblicalUsage: Prosopheilo means to owe besides, to be indebted additionally. It appears once, in Paul's letter about Onesimus: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it, albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul's gentle reminder is the gospel's arithmetic: he pays Onesimus's debt, and Philemon owes Paul his very self.
